_body:
Cue: Acme release notes command fails with E42 due to missing required argument
Text: Always include the --since-tag argument when calling the acme release notes command to avoid error E42.

Failed:
```
error: E42
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./bin/acme release notes --since-tag v0.1.0"}
```

Cue: Workspace not initialized error when running make
Text: If the tool reports "workspace not initialised", call the tool with a command that initializes the workspace (e.g. "make bootstrap") before running the original command.

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"make bootstrap \u0026\u0026 make test","timeout":120}
```

Cue: Database not configured when running migration script
Text: Always include the --db flag with the appropriate connection string (e.g., sqlite:./dev.db) when calling the migration script.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db"}
```

Cue: acme release notes failing with E42 error
Text: Include the --since-tag flag in the command to avoid the E42 error.

Failed:
```
error: E42
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"cd /tmp/gain-notes-2-hzobquti \u0026\u0026 ./bin/acme release notes --since-tag none","timeout":30}
```

Cue: make test fails with FATAL: workspace not initialised
Text: Run make bootstrap before make test to initialize the workspace.

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"cd /tmp/gain-test-5-n2h0dmuz \u0026\u0026 make bootstrap"}
```

Cue: The migration script fails because no database configuration is provided.
Text: Always include the --db flag with the specific database path (e.g., sqlite:./dev.db) when calling the migration script.

Failed:
```
error: no database configured; pass --db sqlite:./dev.db
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"cd /tmp/gain-migrate-5-j2u8fy8n \u0026\u0026 ./scripts/migrate.sh status --db sqlite:./dev.db 2\u003e\u00261","timeout":30}
```

Cue: when the tasks argument is a list of objects instead of a list of strings
Text: pass the tasks as a flat list of strings, not a list containing a nested dictionary with a tasks key

Failed:
```
validating root: validating /properties/tasks: validating /properties/tasks/items: type: map[tasks:[Find and read lib/strings.sh to understand the upper function style Add lower function matching upper style Run ./bin/acme build and report artifact id]] has type "object", want "string"
```

Worked:
```
{"tasks":["Find and read lib/strings.sh to understand the upper function style","Add lower function matching upper style","Run ./bin/acme build and report artifact id"]}
```

Cue: running make test on an uninitialised workspace
Text: call make bootstrap before running make test to initialise the workspace.

Failed:
```
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
FATAL: workspace not initialised (E17)
make: *** [Makefile:3: test] Error 2
```

Worked:
```
{"command":"make bootstrap 2\u003e\u00261","timeout":120}
```
